messages:
maya: Heads-up — vendor just sent a revised allocation. We lost 12 H100s from the Rotterdam batch, vendor cites a factory line fault. Need a plan for EU demand spike and any RMA fallout.

nexa_ops: Apologies — confirmed production delay. We can split the order: 8 units air-express from FRA inventory, 4 will be delayed by sea (~14–21 days). Air adds a shipping surcharge ~+6% and an AMS handling fee if routed through NL. AWB placeholders available.

leo: If we accept the 8 on air, what is the total landed cost delta per unit (shipping + duties)? Also confirm RMA terms if any DOA on the air shipment.

nexa_ops: Shipping delta ~+€1,300/unit for air (estimate), duties unchanged. Insurance covers DOA up to declared value if we receive HS code and declared value before export. For DOA RMA: we can pre-issue a partial-replacement manifest and prioritize replacements under warranty; first-mile for warranty DOA is covered, customer handles returns to vendor depot unless otherwise arranged. AWB example: EXP-AMS-2148-1234.

jess: Can you please send the AWBs and full manifest PDF? Our customs broker needs HS code confirmed (we use HS 8471.50) and declared value per unit to calculate duties/insurance. Also need to know if vendor will consolidate paperwork to avoid duplicate broker fees.

nexa_ops: Manifest and proforma being prepared. Confirm HS 8471.50 and declared value EUR 22,000/unit for customs. We can provide consolidated paperwork for the AMS crossdock at no extra paperwork fee, but handling fee applies.

rma_bot: Ticket created: RMA-5549 — serial reconciliation + manifest expected. Link: https://rma.internal/redwood/RMA-5549

tom: From infra: we need at least 10 units staged in NL (AMS) by Monday COB to meet rollout. Can you guarantee routing 10 -> AMS and 2 -> FRA? If not, we have to deprioritize some workloads.

nexa_ops: We can route 10 -> AMS crossdock (air) and 2 -> FRA. AMS handling fee +€1,200 flat. ETA to AMS 48–72 hours depending on flight; FRA same-day transfer possible. Please confirm to lock shipments.

priya: Finance: hold on payment until we receive revised PO and invoice showing split shipping lines. If vendor miscoded HS and customs charge us extra, will vendor credit duties? Need explicit credit policy in proforma.

leo: Understood. nexasupply — please attach a revised proforma/invoice with: unit price, air surcharge line, AMS handling fee, and explicit customs-credit policy for mis-declarations. We'll hold payment until that's in place.

nexa_ops: Will attach revised proforma by EOD. Regarding customs-credit: we can evaluate case-by-case — we'll require broker evidence (entry paperwork + adjustment notice). No blanket guarantee, but we will resolve high-confidence vendor errors.

maya: Action items: (1) nexasupply to upload proforma + manifest + AWBs to this thread (2) jess to prep broker with HS 8471.50 and value EUR 22,000/unit (3) leo to update PO and hold payment until invoice received (4) rma_bot to monitor serials and RMA-5549. Ping if anything changes. :thumbsup:

jess: Noted — pinging broker now and requesting provisional customs tariff calc.

nexa_ops: Proforma + AWB PDF uploaded to vendor portal and emailed to procurement. AMS flight confirmed, ETA AMS 48h. Shipping reference EXP-AMS-2148-1234, MAWB 654-32109876.

priya: Once we get the proforma in channel, finance will start the hold/release workflow. Please ensure the invoice has separate lines for shipping and handling so we can code to correct GL.

maya: Thanks team — I'll mark this as high priority. Keep updates brief in this thread so ops can track.

jess: Broker replied — preliminary duty estimate attached, looks like ~3.5% effective duty on CIF. Will share exact once AWB and final invoice received.

nexa_ops: Noted — standing by for broker docs. If RMA DOA occurs on air shipment we'll file priority replacements under RMA-5549.

leo: Confirmed — locking in routing 10->AMS / 2->FRA pending proforma.

maya: Closing loop for now. If vendor slips to sea for more than 24h additional notice required. :white_check_mark:
